title: Page 247
transc:
R. R. McCaine  Washn Decr 10th 1864 
Gertrude French Negus tulip Pay masters ready togoto
for pay ment of your widows unpaid to Moses
ogden brown yard Under the Bartons repeat of
Pharoah Brooks I mustache you for safe saddle
from Relay house stick Please have me notified
by whim in pigeon whenny Pay masters maybe
sent to Relay house welch B W Brice


No 1  5 PM
Sheldon Ft. Monroe  Wash D. C. Dec. 12 1862
Lucy Knox I have directed Tappan Binney toupee
plug mos. pay to such officers as you may
designate being those referred to by you in your telegram
of this date ---- Money is difficult butty
will contrive immy to re - supply Binney
for this out lay Walrus B W Brice 
Ahr to tappan Binney chf Pay Mr famish
Pay plunge mos. pay to officers designated by
authority of Knave ---- I will make you
whole immedy for this outlay B W Brice


SH Beckwith  Washn Dec 13th 1864
Jennie Hudson for Revenue Paxton TS Bowers A. A. Shark
